edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow [full legal name] and Defendant Delmar [full legal name] wish to resolve the claims arising from [identify dispute and, if applicable, action and case number] (the “Dispute”). This Agreement becomes effective upon signature by both parties (the “Effective Date”).

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency] (the “Settlement Amount”) within [number] business days after the Effective Date, by [agreed payment method] pursuant to payment instructions independently verified with Plaintiff's counsel. These bracketed terms remain subject to express client approval.

2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff's receipt of the Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims that cannot lawfully be waived. Any dismissal requirements, including timing, prejudice, and allocation of costs, remain subject to express agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the settlement terms confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality duties; disclosures required by law, court order, or legal process; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted, a party compelled to disclose shall give the other party reasonable advance notice and disclose only what is required. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits reporting possible legal violations to, communicating or cooperating with, or providing information to a governmental or regulatory authority, or requires notice or consent for such activity.

Before execution, confirm governing law, enforcement forum, signature blocks and signing authority, any pending-action dismissal mechanics, and whether additional standard provisions are appropriate. No settlement amount or other bracketed term is approved by this draft.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow [full legal name] and Defendant Delmar [full legal name] wish to resolve the claims arising from [identify dispute and, if applicable, court, action title, and case number] (the “Dispute”). This draft is for discussion only and is not binding. Once all bracketed terms have been completed and expressly approved by both clients, this Agreement becomes effective upon signature by both parties (the “Effective Date”).

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds shall Plaintiff release Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims that cannot lawfully be waived. If an action is pending, the parties shall, within [number] business days after that receipt, execute and file the documents necessary to dismiss [identify action and claims] [with/without prejudice], subject to applicable court requirements. Costs and attorneys’ fees shall be allocated as follows: [agreed allocation]. No dismissal shall be filed or become effective before receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds. Any court order retaining jurisdiction to enforce this Agreement must be obtained before dismissal where required by applicable law. If no action is pending, the dismissal provisions shall be marked inapplicable before execution.

5. GOVERNING LAW AND ENFORCEMENT FORUM. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of [agreed jurisdiction], without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. Subject to any valid order retaining jurisdiction in the pending action, proceedings to enforce this Agreement shall be brought exclusively in [identify agreed courts and location], and each party consents to personal jurisdiction and venue there. This provision does not confer subject-matter jurisdiction on any court.

6. EXECUTION AND AUTHORITY. Each person signing represents that the person has authority to bind the party identified in that signature block. Counsel’s transmission of or comments on this draft do not constitute client approval or execution. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts and by electronic signature to the extent permitted by applicable law; together, the executed counterparts constitute one instrument.
